title: `DEBUG_BREAK` is cleared and otherwise ignored.
text: The poll [`ir::InstKind::Safepoint`] lowers to drops that flag where `CPU_LIMIT` and `CANCEL` stop the request: there is no debugger to hand the frame to, and the frame a breakpoint stops in is `nvs dap`'s question rather than this crate's. Nothing in this crate is what is missing; see `nvs_runtime::nvs_safepoint`.
